description: This PHP script handles saving a role in SuiteCRM. It retrieves and updates role data, manages module relationships based on user input, and redirects after saving.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creatingberry Beans, used to instantiate the 'Roles' bean.

methods.name: newBean
methods.description: Creates and returns a new bean object for the specified module.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a record from the database into the bean object based on the provided ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the bean object to the database.

methods.name: clear_module_relationship
methods.description: Clears existing module relationships for a given record.

methods.name: set_module_relationship
methods.description: Sets module relationships for a record, either allowing or disallowing modules.
